programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion-dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton), comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she and Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch, and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: Almost Unsolved
programme.desc: A young Indigenous woman goes missing during a visit from her remote hometown and the clock is ticking as police use the latest computer forensics to track down her last known whereabout.

programme.title: Almost Unsolved
programme.desc: A wealthy California inventor is found shot to death on his kitchen floor. Money is the motive, but all the suspects have airtight alibis.

programme.title: World's Most Evil Killers
programme.desc: Peter Moore was a sadistic serial killer who killed and mutilated four men in North Wales in 1995. The local cinema owner had an obsession with Nazis and sadomasochistic sex.

programme.title: World's Most Evil Killers

programme.title: I Shouldn't Be Alive

programme.title: South Park: Asspen
programme.desc: Asspen: When the boys go on a ski vacation, it's '80s-teen-movie central as Stan is challenged to a ski race by a professional skier named Tad. Only a "montage" can help Stan now! (S6, E02)

programme.title: South Park: The New Terrance and Phillip Move Trailer
programme.desc: The Terrance and Phillip Movie Trailer: The gang are desperate to see the Terrance and Phillip trailer (featuring during 'The Russell Crowe Show') but events conspire against them. (S6, E05)
programme.sub-title: The New Terrance and Phillip Move Trailer

programme.title: South Park: Fun with Veal
programme.desc: Fun With Veal: When the boys discover that veal is made from baby cows they are horrified. Time for a "terrorist" mission to rescue the poor little blighters from their deathly fate! (S6, E04)

programme.title: South Park: Krazy Kripples
programme.desc: Krazy K******s: Christopher Reeve arrives in town and Jimmy and Timmy aren't happy with the attention he gets. They form a club called "The Crips" - unaware of the gang that shares the name! (S7, E02)

programme.title: South Park: Toilet Paper
programme.desc: Toilet Paper: Mrs. Dreibel gives the boys detention for making a phallus out of clay in art class. Angry, they take revenge by toilet papering her house. Officer Barbrady is on their trail. (S7, E03)

programme.title: South Park: Fat Butt and Pancake Head
programme.desc: Fat Butt and Pancake Head: When Cartman wins a diversity event with his offensive hand puppet impersonation of Jennifer Lopez, Kyle is enraged. Soon the real J-Lo turns up, mightily peeved! (S7, E05)

programme.title: South Park: Lil' Crime Stoppers
programme.desc: Lil' Crime Stoppers: Stan, Kyle, Cartman and Kenny decide to play detective; they go around the town solving minor "crimes" for a dollar. It's not long before they're busting meth labs! (S7, E06)

programme.title: South Park: Red Man's Greed
programme.desc: Red Man's Greed: When the entire town is bought out by a Native American casino, the boys come up with a plan to get their homes back - but is more gambling really the solution? (S7, E07)

programme.title: South Park: South Park Is Gay
programme.desc: South Park is Gay! The TV show Queer Eye For The Straight Guy is sweeping the nation and the men of South Park are embracing metrosexuality, but what evil plan are the hosts plotting? (S7, E08)

programme.title: South Park: Christian Rock Hard
programme.desc: Christian Hard Rock: The boys form a band called Moop, but disagree on what direction they should take. Cartman leaves the band and bets them he will have a platinum record first! (S7, E09)

programme.title: South Park: Grey Dawn
programme.desc: Grey Dawn: There's an epidemic in South Park. An epidemic of senior citizen related driving accidents! When their licenses are all revoked they decide to fight back military style! (S7, E10)

programme.title: South Park: Casa Bonita
programme.desc: Casa Bonita: Cartman is overjoyed at going to a Mexican restaurant for Kyle's birthday but is crushed when he finds out Butters is invited instead. He'll have to make Butters "disappear". (S7, E11)

programme.title: South Park: All About Mormons
programme.desc: All About The Mormons: A new family moves to South Park and their son Gary is an unusually perfect Mormon - this angers the boys no end! Will Stan beat him up or go for a family dinner?! (S7, E12)

programme.title: South Park: Butt Out
programme.desc: Butt Out: When the boys' smoking leads to a nasty incident, it's the cigarettes that are blamed rather than them. Cue the glutinous Rob Reiner to arrive in town with his anti-smoking lobby! (S7, E13)

programme.title: South Park: Raisins
programme.desc: Raisins: When Wendy breaks up with Stan he takes it hard. The boys decide to take him to the restaurant Raisins, where all of the employees are preteen girls who enjoy wearing heavy make-up. (S7, E14)

programme.title: South Park: It's Christmas In Canada
programme.desc: It's Christmas In Canada: A law is passed in Canada, meaning poor lil' Ike must return to his biological parents. The boys set out to stop this but who is the evil mastermind behind the law? (S7, E15)

programme.title: South Park: Good Times with Weapons
programme.desc: Good Times With Weapons: After buying martial arts weapons at a local flea market, the boys are transformed into anime Japanese Warriors, with dire consequences for poor Professor Chaos. (S8, E01)

programme.title: South Park: Hotter Than Summer: AWESOM-O
programme.desc: AWESOM-O: When Cartman disguises himself as a robot in order to play a prank on Butters, he ends up being used by movie execs to come up with film ideas and captured by the military! (S8, E05)

programme.title: South Park: Up the Down Steroid
programme.desc: Up The Down Steroid: Jimmy is due to take part in the Special Olympics but what dodgy substance is he talked into taking? Cartman fakes being disabled so he can enter and win a $1,000. (S8, E02)

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: El estrés puede producir efectos poderosos y destructivos. Puede debilitar tanto el cuerpo, como la mente. Puede detariorar las relaciones. Incluso puede hacer que un alma se haga vulnerable a lo sobrenatural.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba

programme.title: Toña Machetes
programme.desc: Toña Machetes es una brava mujer que logró elevarse por encima de los prejuicios sociales de los años 30. Dueña de una gran extensión de tierra y temida por su carácter, vive separada de su esposo aristócrata y acechada por constantes amenazas de muerte.

programme.title: Tres lecciones de amor
programme.desc: Tin-Tan es un vendedor de productos de belleza que conoce aun grupo de hermosas jóvenes que aspiran a ser modelos. Decide ayudarlas y organiza una exhibición de modas que las hace triunfar en la Televisión.

programme.title: Yo soy Chucho el Roto
programme.desc: El carpintero Jesús Arriaga se enamora de Erica Matilde, pero los tíos de ella se oponen a la relación y lo arrestan por robo. Se fuga de la cárcel y se convierte en un bandido generoso.

programme.title: Ahí viene Martín Corona
programme.desc: Martín Corona (Pedro Infante) y "Piporro" son campeones de los pobres, los desafortunados, y las mujeres, pero Carmen Linares y Rosario Medina no caen por su carisma.

programme.title: Corona de lágrimas
programme.desc: Refugio trabaja como contadora para poder mantener a sus tres hijos. Sin embargo, la vida de todos da un giro cuando uno de ellos es llevado a la cárcel y tienen que resolver sus propios problemas.

programme.title: Cuidado con el Amor
programme.desc: Pedro, con la ayuda de dos mejores amigos de su padre busca un Tesoro enterrado en una hacienda colonial. Elsa y su madre quieren impedirlo. Al fin el amor interviene y Pedro y Elsa comparten la fortuna y su felicidad.

programme.title: El Enamorado
programme.desc: Martin Corona encuentra el amor y promote a su esposa a no volver a usar armas, hasta que sus enemigos lo obligan a volver a luchar, ahora por defender a su propia familia.

programme.title: El ataúd del vampiro
programme.desc: Los ladrones de tumbas se topan con la tumba de un vampiro, que los convierte en zombies para cumplir su voluntad, que es acechar y capturar mujeres hermosas.

programme.title: El barón del terror
programme.desc: Una víctima de la inquisición del siglo XVII regresa 300 años después como una bestia devoradora de cerebros a cobrar venganza.

programme.title: El espejo de la bruja
programme.desc: En el siglo XIX, en una lóbrega mansión frente a un espejo mágico, una bruja previene de muerte a una mujer.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: A ninguno de los chicos de las Vacas de South Park les gusta jugar al béisbol y siempre hacen lo posible para perder. El problema es que los otros equipos de la liga hacen lo mismo que ellos y sus esfuerzos por perder son más exitosos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman cree que está muerto porque nadie responde a sus acciones. Se da cuenta que está atorado en la Tierra por sus fechorías, por lo que trata de hacer el bien dando regalos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Jimmy tiene que tomar a tiempo el control de sus hormonas iracundas para presentarse en el concurso de talentos de la escuela.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan y Cartman chocan contra una represa de castores e inundan un pueblo cercano. Como resultado, la ciudad de South Park es declarada en estado de emergencia, ya que todo el mundo piensa que es obra del calentamiento global.
programme.sub-title: Dos días antes de pasado mañana

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Butters debe fingir su muerte, vestirse como una niña e infiltrarse en una fiesta de pijamas con el fin de obtener un dispositivo para ver el futuro, que Cartman está convencido de que las chicas tienen.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La señora Garrison se percata de que aún siente algo por el señor Esclavo, pero él ha planeado casarse con su nuevo amor, el Gran Gay Al, así que decide hacer todo lo que sea posible para detener la ley que permite el matrimonio gay.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman promueve el odio en la escuela hacia los niños con cabello rojo, pecas y piel pálida, diciendo que no tienen alma y no sobreviven al sol. Kyle, indignado, decide convertirlo en uno.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan acepta hacerse un test de personalidad que le ofrecen unos cientólogos. Tras descubrirse que su "nivel de alma" es sorprendentemente alto, Stan es reconocido como la reencarnación del fundador de la Iglesia de la Cientología.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los locutores del show de la ballena Jambú en el Parque Acuático de Denver le hacen creer a los chicos que Jambú puede hablar, que se llama Willzyx, está enferma y es de la luna.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Hay una imagen milagrosa en South Park y muchos creyentes, incluyendo a Randy March, padre de Stan, acuden a buscar solución a sus problemas.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan persuade al pueblo entero para que manejen autos híbridos, sin saber que estos nuevos vehículos causan un tipo distinto de emisiones peligrosas.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Toallín escribe un libro y es seleccionado para el club de Oprah. Se convierte en best-seller ayudando a muchos en sus adicciones. Una parte del equipo de Oprah revela la verdad acerca del libro.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Al Gore visita South Park e intenta convencer a Stan, Kyle, Cartman y Kenny para salir a cazar al peligroso hombre-oso-cerdo. Al ayudarlo, los chicos se quedan atrapados en una cueva y mientras tratan de salir, Cartman descubre un tesoro.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cuando la mamá de Cartman se da cuenta que ya no puede controlarlo busca ayuda de un experto. César Millan, el "susurrador de perros", acepta el reto pero Cartman no cederá sin antes pelear.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los niños juegan al World of Warcraft, pero son constantemente asesinados por un jugador desconocido. Ante la imposibilidad de los creadores del juego de detenerlo, los chicos deciden hacerlo ellos mismos.
programme.sub-title: Haz el amor, no el warcraft

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman le insiste a sus amigos que los ataques terroristas del 11 de Septiembre fueron una conspiración y se dispone a desenmascarar la verdad. Por su parte, el Sr. Mackey quiere saber quién defecó en el baño.
programme.sub-title: El misterio del mojón en el urinal

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman, el nuevo guardián del pasillo en la escuela de South Park, se toma su nuevo cargo demasiado en serio. Mientras tanto, Ike, el hermanito de Kyle, comienza una relación romántica con su maestra de jardín de infantes.
programme.sub-title: Una maestra tiene sexo con un niño

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Satanás está organizando la fiesta de disfraces más grande de Halloween y nadie entra sin su pulsera azul, pero las travesuras de los más notables asesinos seriales de todos los tiempos arruinan todo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El Señor Garrison le explica a la clase la Teoría de la Evolución, aunque está totalmente en contra de esa postura. Mientras tanto, Cartman no puede esperar a que llegue el día del lanzamiento de una consola de videojuegos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman se congela a sí mismo, despertando 500 años en el futuro cuando hay nutrias agresivas y lo peor de todo: ¡No hay Nintendo Wii! ¿Podrá Cartman escapar de ese crudo futuro?

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan se convierte en entrenador de un equipo de hockey y trata de hacerlos ganadores. Mientras tanto, su padre tiene que lidiar con el recuerdo de una presentación de Stan en un partido de años atrás.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Randy usa la palabra con "N" en televisión y enfrenta el ridículo público. Una persona pequeña visita South Park y Cartman no puede dejar de burlarse de él.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El padre de Butters lo encuentra en una posicion comprometedora con Cartman, por lo que decide enviar a su hijo a un campamento especial.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cuando una epidemia de piojos en la cabeza llega a la Escuela de South Park, la señora Garrison se rehúsa a decir qué niño inició la plaga, por lo que Cartman decide investigar quién fue.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los ciudadanos de South Park se están preparando para la llegada de Hillary Clinton a una campaña política. Cartman sospecha que un nuevo estudiante musulmán está envuelto en un ataque terrorista.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan investiga por qué son decorados los huevos de Pascua, y qué tienen que ver los conejos y los huevos con la muerte de Jesús por sus pecados, por lo que se adentra en una sociedad bizarra con Kyle.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La señora Garrison es abandonada y se desquita con sus alumnos de 4o. grado, quienes se fastidian de su actitud y de tanta tarea, y descubren que pueden pagarle a personas por "trabajos".

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Las personas sin hogar en South Park aumentan conforme comen, duermen y ruegan por cambio en las calles. Los adultos tratan de solucionarlo pero los chicos tratan de resolverlo de una vez por todas.
programme.sub-title: La noche de los vagabundos vivientes

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Al ver a un chico con el síndrome de Tourette en una juguetería, Cartman se obsesiona con el tema y se percata de que puede decir lo que quiera sin consecuencias, por lo que se aprovecha de eso.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Randy Marsh se convierte en un héroe local cuando los chicos ven el tamaño de su defecada. Luego de platicar con ellos él cree que puede romper el récord mundial pero alguien más quiere lograrlo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Una apuesta iniciada porque Cartman vio a un duende es el inicio de un problema, aunado a que los chicos se encuentran frente a la totalidad imaginativa del mundo atacada por un grupo terrorista.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan y Kyle han sido capturados por el Pentágono para que le digan al gobierno exactamente cómo entraron a "Imaginaciónlandia". Mientras tanto, Cartman no se da por vencido en su apuesta con Kyle.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: En "Imaginaciónlandia", Stan y Butters luchan contra un ejército de fuerzas imaginarias. La Suprema Corte declara que las criaturas imaginarias no son reales y planean destruir "Imaginaciónlandia".

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan y Kyle se obsesionan tanto con Guitar Hero que llegan al punto de romper récords, lo que hace que Stan considere llegar más lejos consiguiendo un compañero diferente.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Las chicas de cuarto grado han creado una lista secreta que posiciona a los chicos desde los más guapos hasta los más feos. Pero cuando ellos roban la lista, los resultados no son lo que esperaban.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Después de que una rutina de tonsilectomía sale horriblemente mal, Cartman se enfrenta cara a cara con su propia mortalidad.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cuando los chicos ayudan a Britney Spears a llegar al Polo Norte, descubren el secreto impactante detrás de su popularidad.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: En el homenaje de South Park a la película "Heavy Metal", los chicos tratan de que Kenny se libre de la última locura por las drogas que ha capturado a la escuela.

programme.title: Ataque solar
programme.desc: Científicos luchan contra el tiempo para evitar una catástrofe global.

programme.title: El enviado de Dios
programme.desc: La llegada de un perro a una familia en sufrimiento trae consuelo y compañía.

programme.title: Una visita al pasado
programme.desc: Una estrella de fútbol viaja en el tiempo para recuperar su gloria.

programme.title: Nicotina
programme.desc: Diego Luna interpreta a Lolo, un chico acomplejado y tímido.

programme.title: La nueva furia del dragón
programme.desc: Con Jackie Chan. Dos jóvenes lideran estudiantes chinos contra un maestro japonés.

programme.title: Pánico en la nieve
programme.desc: Tres esquiadores quedan atrapados en un telesilla bajo el frío extremo.

programme.title: Templario
programme.desc: Un Caballero Templario y algunos hombres de los Barones luchan contra el tiránico Rey Juan.

programme.title: Bajo custodia
programme.desc: Una mujer despierta en una sala de interrogatorio de la policía sin recordar cómo llegó allí.

programme.title: Persecución en la nieve
programme.desc: Un veterano de guerra termina en una cacería mortal cuando se ve involucrado en un crimen.

programme.title: Verônica
programme.desc: Una maestra, rodeada de violencia y narcotráfico, debe proteger a un niño de 8 años cuyos padres fueron asesinados por traficantes.

programme.title: Los Ojos del Dragon
programme.desc: Hong usa su visión moral y sus habilidades para pelear y salvar a un vecindario de los narcotraficantes y policías corruptos.

programme.title: Cerca al enemigo
programme.desc: Un importante cargamento de droga desaparece entre la frontera de Canadá y EE.UU. Los narcotraficantes que la están buscando obligan a un guarda forestal, antiguo miembro de las Fuerzas Especiales, a ayudarlos a encontrar la droga.

programme.title: Rostros en la Oscuridad
programme.desc: Una mujer vive con "ceguera facial" después de sobrevivir al ataque de un asesino en serie. Mientras vive con su condición, una en la que los rasgos faciales cambian cada vez que los pierde de vista, el asesino se acerca.

programme.title: Crimen en Primer Grado
programme.desc: Claire (Ashley Judd), una abogada dinámica, y su marido (James Caviezel), un contratista independiente de éxito, llevan una vida estupenda. Sin embargo, un delito fortuito en su hogar desencadena una serie de acontecimientos que hace añicos su mundo.

programme.title: El mediador
programme.desc: Danny Roman es un experto negociador en secuestros, pero esta vez está del otro lado: obligado por una acusación falsa, ha secuestrado a las cabezas de Asuntos Internos, exigiendo mediador.

programme.title: Incompatibles
programme.desc: Un capitán de la brigada criminal de París (Laurent Lafitte) y un investigador de delitos financieros (Omar Sy) se reúnen con motivo del asesinato de la mujer de un líder de la patronal.

programme.title: La Frontera
programme.desc: Una reportera americana busca a su hermano perdido en contra de la violencia y el robo a través de la frontera entre Estados Unidos y México.

programme.title: Secretos Peligrosos
programme.desc: Una agente de la policía de Nebraska viaja a Bosnia como observadora de las Naciones Unidas tras la guerra de los Balcanes. Allí descubre la existencia de una red de trata de blancas.

programme.desc: Sumérgete en los ritmos que te aceleran el corazón y las melodías vibrantes de las estrellas más grandes de la música latina.

programme.title: Gangster Nº 1
programme.desc: Un mafioso recuerda su ascenso en el Londres de los años sesenta. La ambición y la envidia lo llevan a traicionar a su mentor, Freddie Mays, para convertirse en el gánster más temido de la ciudad.

programme.title: Headhunters
programme.desc: Un reclutador corporativo, quien también se dedica a robar arte, planea robar una pintura valiosa del candidato perfecto para un trabajo vacante.

programme.title: Memorias de Queens
programme.desc: Nueva York, años ochenta. Astoria, en el barrio de Queens, es un sitio duro para crecer. Los adolescentes se pasan el día peleándose, sobre todo los puertorriqueños con los italianos. Por otra parte, las hormonas están en plena revolución.

programme.title: Arcadia
programme.desc: Greta, de 12 años, es llevada a través del país por su padre, quien intenta mantener unida a su familia tras la ruptura de su matrimonio.

programme.title: Manos de seda
programme.desc: Juan, un carterista de poca monta, sobrevive con pequeños encargos para Ruth, dueña de un garito de póker. Al seguir a Silvia, esposa de un ludópata, para cobrar una deuda, se verá envuelto en una situación inesperada.

programme.title: Salto al vacío
programme.desc: Alex es una chica de 20 años que se hace cargo de la manutención de su familia con el tráfico ilegal de armas. Es la única chica en un mundo de hombres, dividida entre la necesidad de encontrar el amor y una vida basada en la violencia.

programme.title: Escándalo
programme.desc: La historia sigue el romance entre una bailarina exótica y el ministro de Guerra, una relación que sacude al gobierno británico. Basada en el escándalo Profumo de 1963.

programme.title: Un mes en el campo
programme.desc: Tras la Primera Guerra Mundial, Tom Birkin llega a un pueblo del norte de Inglaterra para restaurar un antiguo mural oculto en una iglesia. Su presencia despierta el recelo del reverendo y de unos vecinos reacios a cambiar el orden establecido.

programme.title: La ola
programme.desc: El experimento de un profesor de instituto para demostrar a sus alumnos cómo es la vida bajo una dictadura se descontrola terriblemente cuando forma una unidad social con vida propia.

programme.title: Algo Prestado
programme.desc: Las amistades se ponen a prueba y los secretos salen a la luz cuando Rachel, soltera recalcitrante, se enamora de Dex, el prometido de su mejor amiga Darcy.

programme.title: El duodécimo hombre
programme.desc: En 1943, en la Noruega ocupada por Alemania, un grupo de saboteadores es traicionado y apresado por las tropas nazis. De los 12 integrantes del comando, sólo uno consigue sobrevivir.

programme.title: Prisioneros del sol
programme.desc: Una expedición multinacional descubre una ciudad perdida bajo una pirámide en la que tendrán que detener a los dioses del antiguo Egipto que han despertado para iniciar el apocalipsis.

programme.title: Dredd
programme.desc: Una prostituta convertida en traficante de drogas pretende apoderarse de la ciudad futurista de Mega City One. El Juez Dredd, miembro destacado de una fuerza policial de élite, es la última esperanza de la ciudad.

programme.title: Ong Bak 2
programme.desc: Un joven boxeador tailandés aprende las habilidades y el significado profundo de las artes marciales.

programme.title: El Regreso Del Samurai
programme.desc: Tras cumplir una condena de diez años de prisión, Lin regresa a casa para dejar atrás sus errores.

programme.title: Rescate en Damasco
programme.desc: Adib Abdel Kareem escapó de Siria hace más de 30 años, dejando atrás al amor de su vida, Fátima, para establecerse en Toronto y empezar una nueva vida. Pero ahora debe regresar a su país cuando su hija Muna, que es periodista, desaparece en Damasco.

programme.title: El heredero del billón de dólares
programme.desc: Guido Falcone tiene que viajar, dentro de veinte días, a San Francisco desde su Italia natal para reclamar su herencia de un billón de dólares.

programme.title: El ladrón de Shanghai
programme.desc: Con la ayuda de un maestro en artes marciales, un intrépido joven se hace pasar por un príncipe llegado de un lejano país para poder casarse con la hija del Rey y aspirar al trono.

programme.title: ISRA-88
programme.desc: Un científico y un piloto se ofrecen voluntarios para una misión de alto nivel destinada a llegar al fin del universo. Después de 13 años, la nave se estrella en el fin del universo y se adentra en lo desconocido.

programme.title: CAT. 8
programme.desc: Con la esperanza de presentar un sistema de defensa global fiable, una científica desencadena un desastre magnético.

programme.title: Un Trabajo Embarazoso
programme.desc: Thea, una joven ejecutiva, finge estar embarazada para evitar que su empresa la despida. Cuando todo el mundo multiplica sus atenciones hacia ella y empieza a recibir cada vez más ayuda, no le queda otra salida que mantener la mentira durante nueve meses.

programme.title: La felicidad nunca viene sola
programme.desc: Un músico conoce a una mujer con una vida muy distinta y ambos se enamoran.

programme.title: Donkey Xote
programme.desc: Rucio, el burro de Sancho Panza, decide contar la historia de Don Quijote. De hecho Rucio insiste en que el caballero no está tan loco y fuera de lo común como muchos piensan.

programme.title: Dance-Off
programme.desc: Brandon y Jasmine son dos bailarines pertenecientes a academias rivales que deben competir por un gran premio. En su viaje a la final el enfrentamiento se va convirtiendo en amor.

programme.title: Querida Elisabeth
programme.desc: La vida de Sid Straw se desmorona a medida que trata de demostrar a sus amigos que entabló amistad con una celebridad mientras estaba en la universidad.

programme.title: Tras la pista del zorro
programme.desc: Aldo Vanucci (Peter Sellers), también conocido como "el Zorro", es un ingenioso y brillante ladrón. A lo largo de su agitada carrera, se ha hecho pasar por los más variados personajes, desde sacerdote a carabinero.

programme.title: Red Dog, una historia de lealtad
programme.desc: Basada en una historia real, la película cuenta cómo un perro recorre Australia creando vínculos con los habitantes de un pueblo minero, convirtiéndose en un símbolo de amistad y lealtad.

programme.title: Primavera en Normandía
programme.desc: Un panadero observa cómo su vecina repite sin saberlo la historia de Madame Bovary.

programme.title: Tipos Legales
programme.desc: Val (Al Pacino) sale de la cárcel tras cumplir 28 años de condena. Doc (Christopher Walken), su mejor amigo, le espera a la salida para ir a ver a Hirsch (Alan Arkin), otro viejo colega.

programme.title: Compassionate Sex
programme.desc: En una desolada aldea, Dolores, una mujer bondadosa, madura, gordita y cariñosa cincuentona, es abandonada por su marido, hastiado de su excesiva generosidad.

programme.title: Hojas de hierba
programme.desc: Las vidas de dos gemelos dan un giro cuando el primero, un profesor de filosofía, es confundido por el segundo, un traficante de drogas al que varios clanes del narcotráfico quieren ver muerto.

programme.title: Instafama
programme.desc: Una fanática desquiciada de las redes sociales inculpa a su mejor amiga por asesinato.

programme.title: Vacaciones en el infierno
programme.desc: En Vacaciones en el infierno conoceremos a Driver (Mel Gibson), un tipo que ha tenido un mal día. Y la cosa no mejora para él: se ha hecho con un botín de millones de dólares que le habría proporcionado unas vacaciones de verano memorables.

programme.title: Secuestrada en la isla
programme.desc: Una madre soltera arriesga su vida para salvar a su hija, fascinada por las estrellas, de las garras de una red de tráfico sexual dirigida por un agente de talentos en una isla aislada.

programme.title: Puntos extra por asesinato
programme.desc: Maisy se traslada a la universidad de su difunta hermana para investigar las circunstancias de su muerte.

programme.title: Mi obsesión por Rachel
programme.desc: Rachel inicia una relación con Craig, un hombre encantador que irrumpe en su vida con un romanticismo inesperado. Todo parece perfecto… hasta que su verdadera personalidad comienza a salir a la luz.

programme.title: Moebius
programme.desc: En un futuro no muy lejano, un misterioso accidente ocurre en el metro de Buenos Aires: un coche que circulaba por la vía desaparece, perdiéndose en el tiempo debido a un extraño fenómeno que solo un científico puede resolver.

programme.title: Obsession
programme.desc: Sonia Paston acepta una gran promoción laboral que significa dejar su vida en Nueva York para mudarse a un pequeño pueblo cerca de Boston. Aún si ella esta lista para irse, alguien no esta dispuesto a vivir sin ella.

programme.title: Sultanes del Sur
programme.desc: Cuatro profesionales atracan un banco en México. Consiguen un botín de 11 millones de dólares, y se van a Buenos Aires para cambiar los dólares por pesos.

programme.title: Transsiberian
programme.desc: Tras una temporada en Pekín, Roy y Jessie deciden viajar a Moscú en el Transiberiano, el ferrocarril que une la Rusia europea con las provincias rusas del Lejano Oriente.

programme.title: Llamada oculta
programme.desc: Un psicópata utiliza el sistema de seguridad de alta tecnología de una familia para atraparlos en su propia casa.

programme.title: Hitler: El ascenso del mal - Parte 1
programme.desc: Una perspectiva única, que perfila la vida de Adolf Hitler como un niño y su ascenso a través de las filas del Partido Nacional Alemán de los Trabajadores antes de la Segunda Guerra Mundial.

programme.title: Hitler: El ascenso del mal - Parte 2
programme.desc: Una perspectiva única, que perfila la vida de Adolf Hitler como un niño y su ascenso a través de las filas del Partido Nacional Alemán de los Trabajadores antes de la Segunda Guerra Mundial.

programme.title: Nora
programme.desc: Dublín, 1904, James Joyce conversa con Nora Barnacle, una camarera de hotel recién llegada de Galway. Ella lo encanta con su actitud franca y desinhibida y, en poco tiempo, la convence de que lo acompañe a Trieste.

programme.title: El Gran Duelo
programme.desc: En los violentos desiertos del Oeste, y a pesar de las hostilidades de algunos y los intereses conflictivos de otros, Clayton intentar� que se cumpla la Ley.

programme.title: Buñuel y La Mesa del Rey Salomon
programme.desc: El viejo Giacinto vive en los arrabales de una gran ciudad italiana con su esposa, hijos, nueras y nietos. En total casi veinte personas en la misma chabola.

programme.title: Un mes en el campo
programme.desc: Tras la Primera Guerra Mundial, Tom Birkin llega a un pueblo del norte de Inglaterra para restaurar un antiguo mural oculto en una iglesia. Su presencia despierta el recelo del reverendo y de unos vecinos reacios a cambiar el orden establecido.

programme.title: Compassionate Sex
programme.desc: En una desolada aldea, Dolores, una mujer bondadosa, madura, gordita y cariñosa cincuentona, es abandonada por su marido, hastiado de su excesiva generosidad.

programme.title: Cowards
programme.desc: Historia de dos chavales de secundaria, uno la víctima y el otro el verdugo. Guille es, en apariencia, un chico como muchos: buenas notas, buen deportista y con una familia que le respalda.

programme.title: Salto al vacío
programme.desc: Alex es una chica de 20 años que se hace cargo de la manutención de su familia con el tráfico ilegal de armas. Es la única chica en un mundo de hombres, dividida entre la necesidad de encontrar el amor y una vida basada en la violencia.

programme.title: Escándalo
programme.desc: La historia sigue el romance entre una bailarina exótica y el ministro de Guerra, una relación que sacude al gobierno británico. Basada en el escándalo Profumo de 1963.

programme.title: New York, I Love You
programme.desc: Siguiendo los pasos del éxito de "Paris, je t'aime" doce directores y varios actores de primera línea toman la ciudad de Nueva York como set y narran diferentes historias de amor.

programme.title: Primavera en Normandía
programme.desc: Un panadero observa cómo su vecina repite sin saberlo la historia de Madame Bovary.

programme.title: Amor de ida y vuelta
programme.desc: Dos actores de fenómenos televisivos (Juego de Tronos y Sex Education) protagonizan este fantástico romance. Un joven (Asa Butterfield) inventa una máquina del tiempo para recuperar a su exnovia (Sophie Turner).

programme.title: Happy End
programme.desc: A nuestro alrededor, el mundo, y nosotros en medio, ciegos. Una instantánea de la vida de una familia burguesa europea.

programme.title: El mejor día del año
programme.desc: El film narra el viaje inspirador y el cambio vital de un joven a través del misterioso Yellow Day. Para muchos, el Día Amarillo es simplemente un día divertido de celebración mientras que para otros tiene una carga más trascendental.

programme.title: New York, I Love You
programme.desc: Siguiendo los pasos del éxito de "Paris, je t'aime" doce directores y varios actores de primera línea toman la ciudad de Nueva York como set y narran diferentes historias de amor.

programme.title: De nuevo el amor
programme.desc: Chloe y David han decidido terminar su matrimonio pero antes de poderle decir a su hija, ella los soprende con la noticia de su compromiso.

programme.title: Regreso a Montauk
programme.desc: El escritor Max Zorn regresa a Nueva York para la promoción de su última novela, donde le espera su joven esposa Clara, quien lleva meses trabajando allí.

programme.title: Mi casa en París
programme.desc: Mathias, un desventurado neoyorquino sin esposa, sin hijos y sin un céntimo, hereda de su padre, con quien no se hablaba, una enorme en casa en París, de la que quiere deshacerse lo antes posible.

programme.title: 45 Años
programme.desc: Solo falta una semana para que Kate y Geoff Mercer celebren el 45 aniversario de su boda. Geoff recibe una carta comunicándole que ha sido descubierto el cuerpo de su primer amor, congelado e intacto en un glaciar de los Alpes suizos.

programme.title: Alienoid 1
programme.desc: Los guardianes extraterrestres usan huéspedes humanos como prisiones mientras un guardián rastrea a los fugitivos a través de los siglos, mezclando hechiceros taoístas de la dinastía Goryeo y tecnología futurista.

programme.title: Deadly Descent
programme.desc: Descenso Mortal es una película de horror psicológico en el que un grupo de extraños se ve envuelto en un juego de vida o muerte donde se juzgarán los pecados de cada uno de ellos.

programme.title: Batalla de Los Ángeles
programme.desc: En febrero de 1942, las fuerzas estadounidenses se enfrentaron a un OVNI sobre Los Ángeles. Hoy, después de casi 70 años, los invasores alienígenas han regresado.

programme.title: Batalla Espacial: La Armada Ataca
programme.desc: En 2420, después de que una raza de alienígenas y poderosos magos esclavizaran a gran parte de la humanidad, un grupo de rebeldes organiza un contraataque pilotando una flota de naves espaciales.

programme.title: White Space
programme.desc: La tripulación de una nave pesquera espacial se enfrenta a una criatura cósmica gigantesca y mortal mientras opera en un sector inexplorado del espacio.

programme.title: 10.000 días
programme.desc: Hace 10.000 días, un cometa impactó con la Tierra en pleno océano Pacífico con la fuerza de incontables bombas nucleares, sumiendo al planeta en nieve y hielo.

programme.title: El final de la cuenta atrás
programme.desc: En Hawaii, un moderno portaviones de la marina americana se ve envuelto en una extraña tormenta. Tras la tormenta, el capitán descubre que están en el 7 de diciembre de 1941, el día en que los japoneses bombardearon Pearl Harbor.

programme.title: Capitán América
programme.desc: Película de acción de bajo presupuesto basada en el popular superhéroe de Marvel Comics en el que Steven Rogers sigue siendo el Capitán América durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial.

programme.title: Robot Wasteland
programme.desc: En un mundo postapocalíptico dominado por máquinas rebeldes y bandas de saqueadores, una madre y su hija luchan por proteger la última fuente de agua limpia.

programme.title: Fahrenheit 451
programme.desc: En un futuro opresivo Guy Montag, un disciplinado bombero encargado de quemar los libros prohibidos por el gobierno, conoce a una revolucionaria maestra que se atreve a leer.

programme.title: Regreso a Montauk
programme.desc: El escritor Max Zorn regresa a Nueva York para la promoción de su última novela, donde le espera su joven esposa Clara, quien lleva meses trabajando allí.

programme.title: Carga maldita
programme.desc: Cuatro hombres desafortunados aceptan transportar una peligrosa carga de nitroglicerina a través de la peligrosa jungla latinoamericana.

programme.title: No
programme.desc: Ante la presión internacional, el dictador chileno Augusto Pinochet se ve obligado a organizar un referéndum de apoyo a su presidencia en 1988. Los líderes de la oposición convencen a René Saavedra, un joven y atrevido ejecutivo publicitario...

programme.title: Irrational Man
programme.desc: Escrita y dirigida por Woody Allen. Un atormentado profesor de Filosofía (Joaquin Phoenix) encuentra las ganas de vivir cuando comete un acto existencial junto a su amiga y alumna (Emma Stone).

programme.title: La buena mentira
programme.desc: Historia real sobre un joven refugiado de la guerra civil sudanesa que gana la lotería para ser reubicado en Estados Unidos con otros tres niños perdidos.

programme.title: The Ghost Writer
programme.desc: El cineasta Roman Polanski aumenta el suspense en un thriller sobre un escritor (Ewan McGregor) que redacta las memorias de un ex primer ministro (Pierce Brosnan).

programme.title: The Pacifist
programme.desc: Italia, década de los setenta. Una joven periodista de televisión que se declara pacifista, se enamora de un chico que pertenece a un grupo extremista.

programme.title: Fresa y chocolate
programme.desc: David es un comunista convencido que estudia en la Universidad de La Habana. Diego es un artista homosexual acosado por la homofobia del régimen castrista. A pesar de las abismales diferencias que los separan, entre ellos surge una profunda amistad.

programme.title: Reina Cristina
programme.desc: El retrato de la brillante y extravagante Kristina de Suecia, reina desde los seis años, que lucha contra las fuerzas conservadoras que están en contra de sus ideas para modernizar Suecia y que no toleran su sexualidad.

programme.title: Top Gear: Temporada 8, Episodio 4
programme.desc: En uno de nuestros desafíos más espectaculares a la fecha, Richard Hammond viaja a Chipre, donde enfrenta al nuevo Porsche Cayenne Turbo S con el equipo paracaidista de exhibición de RAF, The Red Devils.

programme.title: Top Gear: Temporada 8, Episodio 5
programme.desc: Un espectacular fútbol de coches. Esta competición épica ve a esos viejos candidatos, los Toyota Aygos, enfrentados con el más duro de los oponentes: un equipo de VW Foxes, construidos en Brasil.

programme.title: Top Gear: Temporada 8, Episodio 6

After being cast adrift, she begins a fling with Matty (Owen Wilson), a charming womanizer who plays professional baseball. About the same time, she goes on a blind date with George (Paul Rudd), a businessman on the hook for stock fraud. Caught in a romantic triangle with the two men, Lisa ponders the meaning of love.

On the road, Zak meets Tyler (Shia LaBeouf), a small-time outlaw who becomes Zak's unlikely coach and ally. Together, they set out on a wild, life-changing journey and try to convince Eleanor (Dakota Johnson), a kind nursing-home employee charged with bringing Zak back, to join them.

programme.title: Jacques Bailly, Willy Donni, Bruno Castellucci & José Bedeur
programme.sub-title: Festival international de jazz Adolphe Sax
programme.desc: On June 4, 1962, the first Festival International de Jazz ‘Adolphe Sax' took place in the Belgian town of Dinant, where Adolphe Sax, the inventor of the saxophone, was born in 1814. Not surprisingly, most artists on the program are saxophonists. A Belgian quartet, consisting of tenor saxophonist Jacques Bailly, guitarist Willy Donni, drummer Bruno Castellucci, and bassist José Bedeur, opens the festival. The second highlight of the festival is a trio of Belgian pianist François Boland, who appeared with American bassist Jimmy Woode and Belgian drummer Freddy Rottier. They are joined by four international guest saxophonists: German tenorist Klaus Doldinger, Belgian altoist Jacques Pelzer, British altoist Derek Humble, and Austrian saxophonist Karl Drewo. Following individual solo features and a joint encore, a true saxophone legend appears on stage: veteran American tenorist Coleman Hawkins. Accompanied by his compatriots Jimmy Woode (bass) and “Kansas” Fields (drums) and French pianist George Arvanitas, Coleman Hawkins plays an hour-long concert that includes "Disorder At The Border", "Autumn Leaves", "Lover Come Back To Me", "Moonlight In Vermont", "All The Things You Are" and “Ow!”. This concert is the perfect conclusion of the first jazz festival in honor of Adolphe Sax.

programme.title: Raul Midón
programme.desc: Raul Midón appeared at 2017's Sing Jazz Festival in Singapore with double bassist Romeir Mendez and drummer Billy Williams. Blind since birth, Raul Midón is a singer, guitarist, and songwriter from New Mexico. With a vocal range as dynamic as his guitar playing and a remarkable talent for trumpet mimicry, Midón's performances transcend musical boundaries, effortlessly blending rock, jazz, folk, and Latin pop into his unique sound. He has worked with numerous legends, including Bill Withers, Herbie Hancock, Sting, and Dianne Reeves, and his album ‘Bad Ass and Blind' was nominated for a Grammy Award for Best Jazz Vocal Album in 2018. No wonder the Sing Jazz audience were ecstatic!

programme.title: The Monty Alexander Trio
programme.sub-title: Monty Alexander Quartet - Noth Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. On July 13, 1979, talented Jamaican pianist Monty Alexander was joined by Reggie Johnson (bass), Frank Gant (drums), Bobby Thomas (hand drum), and Othello Molineaux (steel drum) at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Alexander's Caribbean influences and natural flair for the piano shine through in this brilliant performance.

programme.title: Maceo Parker
programme.desc: As a 25-year-old saxophonist, Maceo Parker played in the band of James Brown, but he is also known for his collaborations with George Clinton's Parliament-Funkadelic and Bootsy Collins' Rubber Band. Maceo has proven his star quality by creating a special chemistry between all the different styles of American black music. As a pioneer in the ‘groove', he blends funky jazz with roots and blues with gospel. The result? Overheated concert halls, with enthusiastic audiences that completely surrender themselves to the music's boundless energy.

programme.sub-title: Ode to Miles: Bitches Brew Beyond
programme.desc: For the 40th anniversary of jazz legend Miles Davis' legendary album Bitches Brew, trumpeter Wallace Roney leads a band that revives the master's music. This project is the brainchild of Miles' family (including his son Erin), which is represented by his nephew, drummer Vince Wilburn. This concert at the ancient theater in Vienne, France, is a grand tribute to Miles.

programme.title: John Lee Hooker, Carey Bell, Jimmy Dawkins & Joe Harper
programme.sub-title: John Lee Hooker Live in Paris
programme.desc: In this 1970 performance at Maison de la Radio in Paris, France, American blues legend John Lee Hooker (voice and guitar) is joined by the masterful Carey Bell (harmonica), Joe Harper (bass), Lester Dorsie (drums), and Jimmy Dawkins (electric guitar). From the first to the very last minute of the concert, Hooker illustrates why he, 45 years later, was to be ranked 35th on Rolling Stone's 2015 list of 100 Greatest Guitarists: this bluesman is truly in a class of his own.

programme.title: Franz Welser-Möst & Cleveland Orchestra
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a concert performing a charming work by Mozart, with a sentimental connection to the conductor: Symphony No. 36 'Linz is named after the hometown of Welser-Möst. Mozart wrote the piece when stopping over on a trip from Vienna to Salzburg. Recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland in January 2022.

programme.title: Antoine Tamistit & Robin Ticciati
programme.sub-title: Walton's Viola Concerto & Brahms's Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: British conductor Robin Ticciati conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a performance of William Walton's Viola Concerto and Johannes Brahms's Symphony No. 4 in E minor, Op. 98. When the young Walton premiered his Viola Concerto in 1927, it caused a Europe-wide sensation: a composer in his twenties, taking a neglected instrument and writing for it with unprecedented imagination and power. Viola virtuoso Antoine Tamestit features as the soloist in this Concerto. Brahms's Symphony No. 4 would be the composer's last – but every note burns with creative fire. This concert, which unites youthful genius with music drawn from a profound engagement with life, was recorded at LSO St. Luke's on Old Street in London, UK, on October 14, 2021.

programme.title: Christine Nonbo Andersen, Tuva Semmingsen, David Bateson & Steffen Bruun
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra takes us on a spectacular symphonic space journey in an out-of-this-world concert program of film music. Under the direction of Dutch conductor Antony Hermus, the orchestra guides us through the musical universe, performing a selection of music from iconic sci-fi movies, such as Avatar, Gravity, Interstellar, and Star Wars, written by major composers such as John Williams, Hans Zimmer, and James Horner. Featured soloists in this concert are Tuva Semmingsen, Christine Nonbo Andersen, Steffen Bruun, and David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in August 2021.

programme.title: Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Fabio Luisi, Copenhagen Royal Chapel Choir & MDR Leipzig Radio Choir
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Gustav Mahler's Symphony No. 8. The work is one of the largest-scale choral works in the classical concert repertoire and is frequently called the "Symphony of a Thousand." The work was composed at Mahler's Maiernigg villa in southern Austria in the summer of 1906 and is the last work which was premiered in Mahler's lifetime. Soloists include Ricarda Merbeth (soprano), Henriette Bonde-Hansen (soprano), Sofia Fomini (soprano), Marianne Beate Kielland (alto), Olesya Petrova (alto), Stefan Vinke (tenor), Russel Braun (baritone), and Günther Groissböck (bass). Among the participating choirs are the Danish National Concert Choir, MDR Leipzig Radio Choir and Copenhagen Royal Chapel Choir. Recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in 2017.

programme.title: Ivan Fischer, Budapest Festival Orchestra & Richard Goode
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphonies and Piano Concerto No. 4
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra (BFO) in a concert program dedicated to the music of Ludwig van Beethoven. The program opens with the composer's Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21. Afterward, Fischer conducts Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 4 in G major, Op. 58, in which Richard Goode features as the soloist. The acclaimed American pianist (1943) is known for his interpretations of the Beethoven repertoire. Goode recorded all five Beethoven piano concertos with the BFO and Fischer, earning him exceptional critical acclaim and a Grammy Award nomination. As an encore, Goode performs the Sarabande from J. S. Bach's Partita in B-flat major, BWV 825. The program closes with Beethoven's famous Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. This performance was recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary, on January 29, 2017.

programme.title: Johnny Cash
programme.desc: Johnny Cash was one of the most influential figures in American music in the post war period. He managed to combine elements of folk, rock 'n' roll and country, which together with his distinctive voice and guitar style, created an instantly recognisable sound. 1994 was to prove to be Cash's only appearance at the Montreux Festival. The "Man In Black" had just released his acclaimed American Recordings album and his European tour took in Montreux on July 5. This classic concert features a number of tracks from his new album coupled with favourites from across his career including Folsom Prison Blues, I Walk The Line, Ghost Riders In The Sky, Orange Blossom Special and San Quentin. An added bonus is the guest appearance of his wife June Carter Cash on two tracks. Caught at one of the high points of his distinguished career this is truly Johnny Cash at his best.

Punctuated by Hendrix lighting his instrument on fire, the U.S. debut performance of the Jimi Hendrix Experience at the Monterey Pop Festival propelled the guitarist and his band mates to the top ranks of international rock royalty.

programme.title: Exposed
programme.desc: New York City Detective Galban (Keanu Reeves: John Wick) investigates the brutal murder of his partner. Among the evidence, he finds a photograph of a teacher (Ana de Armas: War Dogs) who he believes may be a vital witness. Co-starring Academy Award Winner Mira Sorvino (Mighty Aphrodite), and Cassian Elwes (Dallas Buyers Club).

A gang of criminals and corrupt cops plan the murder of a police officer in order to pull off a heist.

programme.title: Dead Man Down
programme.desc: A man left for dead goes after the Eastern European mob boss who killed his wife and daughter.

programme.title: The Son of No One

programme.title: The Butterfly Effect
programme.desc: In The Butterfly Effect Evan Treborn (Ashton Kutcher) has lost crucial moments of his life, his childhood scarred by a series of terrifying events he can't remember. When Evan realises that by reading his diaries he can unlock the past and go back in time, he tries to reclaim the missing memories by tampering with the past... with unexpected and disastrous results! The more Evan tampers with time, the more his life - and that of his friend Kayleigh (Amy Smart) - begin to unravel, and he discovers there is no such thing as a happy ending!

programme.title: Pandorum
programme.desc: Two astronauts (Dennis Quaid, Vantage Point and Ben Foster, 30 Days of Night) awaken in a hyper-sleep chamber aboard a seemingly abandoned spacecraft. It's pitch black, they are disoriented, and the only sound is a low rumble and creak from the belly of the ship. They can't remember anything like who they are and what their mission is, but one thing they do realise very quickly is that they are not alone. Slowly the spacecraft's shocking, deadly secrets are revealed and the astronauts find that they must fight to stay alive and that their survival is more important than they could ever have imagined. Directed by Christian Alvart and also starring Cam Gigandet (Twilight), Cung Le (Tekken) and newcomer Antje Traue.

programme.title: The Hitman's Apprentice
programme.desc: When 19-year-old Adam agrees to do a day's driving for his mum's gangster boyfriend Peter, it takes him on a 24-hour journey into a nightmarish world of murder, sex trafficking and revenge, in the company of aging hit man Roy.

programme.title: Adventures of a Taxi Driver
programme.desc: Joe likes the ladies and gets to meet a variety of them in his job as a taxi driver. From dizzy young women to frustrated housewives, Joe fancies them all, and they take a fancy to Joe. If only things were smoother at home for the put-upon cabbie. With his nagging mother, thieving teenage brother, and the attentions of an overbearing girlfriend with ideas of marriage, Joe leaves the homestead and rents the spare room at his best mate's flat. Meanwhile, he continues to find himself in an assortment of humorous sexual escapades until he accidentally becomes embroiled in a jewel heist that doesn't quite go to plan.

programme.title: Open 24 Hours
programme.desc: After surviving and killing her serial killer boyfriend, a young woman rebuilds her life with a new job at an all-night gas station. Haunted by visions of her boyfriend's crimes and delusions of his imminent return, what seems like a routine night becomes one of mayhem and murder. As the bodies start to pile up, will she survive the night?

programme.title: Freehold
programme.desc: Twisted and highly sinister. Hussein, a young amoral London estate agent will do anything to get his commission. His life takes a dramatic turn when he is tormented by an angry ex-client, Orlan (Javier Botet: It) who has claimed Hussein's flat as his, unbeknownst to the estate agent.

programme.title: Bloodthirsty
programme.desc: Frightfest Presents. Ambition can be killer. When an offer to work with one of the greatest music producers of all time comes along, singer Grey cant refuse but her new mentor isnt all that he seems to be. Moving to record her album in a remote location, Grey realises theres a beastly secret lurking. Will her humanity be the price for fame and how much blood will be shed to secure a hit?

programme.title: Lifechanger
programme.desc: From FrightFest Presents. A lean, mean, intense shapeshifter horror, with a chilling message suited to the complexity of the Me Too era. A mysterious “skin-walker” who steals the form, memories, and lives of his victims, leaving behind a withered husk of a corpse - is out on a blood-soaked mission to make things right with the woman he loves. A blend of body horror and serial killer thriller.

programme.title: The Novice
programme.desc: An obsessive college freshman joins her university's rowing team and undertakes an extreme physical and psychological journey to make it to the top varsity boat, no matter the cost.

programme.title: The Bright Side
programme.desc: A stand-up comedian's life changes when she is diagnosed with breast cancer.

programme.title: Come Early Morning
programme.desc: A thirty-something southern woman searches for love, despite the burdens she carries with her.

programme.title: Sweetland
programme.desc: Sweetland is the story of an isolated community at the outermost edge of the world, and the struggles of one man determined to resist its extinction.

programme.title: Christmas in Evergreen
programme.desc: Allie is from the magical small-town of Evergreen. Will her wish for a romantic Christmas come true after a series of events seemingly transpire against her? Starring Ashley Williams. (2017)

programme.title: Christmas at Holly Lodge
programme.desc: Sophie is the proud owner of the perfect Christmas getaway destination. Will her blossoming relationship with a guest end when she discovers his ulterior motive for staying at Holly Lodge? (2017)

programme.title: Merry and Bright
programme.desc: Cate, the CEO of the Merry and Bright candy cane company, assumes her mother is playing matchmaker again when she meets Gabe in the run-up to Christmas. Stars Andrew Walker and Jodie Sweetin. (2019)

programme.title: Love is a Piece of Cake
programme.desc: Jessie Dale is a third generation baker who loves her cake shop more than anything in the world. When developers threaten to buy her building and force her out, she must do all she can to save her bakery, all while juggling a blossoming romance with her client's brother.

programme.title: My Ex-Ex
programme.desc: When Mary's boyfriend Ted invites her out to a fancy restaurant, she's convinced he's going to pop the question. But instead of getting hitched, Mary gets dumped.

programme.title: Blind
programme.desc: Bestselling novelist, Bill Oakland loses his wife and his sight in a vicious car crash. Five years later Socialite Suzanne Dutchman is forced to read to Bill in an intimate room three times a week as a plea bargain for being associated with her husband's insider trading.

programme.title: Elvis And Anabelle
programme.desc: After a miracle, a beauty queen and a small town boy are thrown together in this life affirming story of young love.

programme.title: Frankie and Johnny
programme.desc: Join Elvis Presley and Donna Douglas for a riverboat ride of rollicking musical entertainment in this charming and sassy comic hit about a gambler and his lady love.

programme.title: Lars and the Real Girl
programme.desc: Lars Lindstrom is an akwardly shy young man in a small town who finally brings home the girl of his dreams to his brother and sister-in-law's home. The only problem is that she's not real - she's a sex doll.

programme.title: Christmas in Wonderland
programme.desc: Starring Patrick Swayze and Chris Kattan. Three children and their father move from California to Canada. When they go shopping at the mall, they find counterfeit cash, inadvertently help catch crooks, and make a discovery about Santa.

programme.title: Christmas in Mississippi
programme.desc: Photographer Holly returns to Gulfport, Mississippi for Christmas. Their traditional holiday light show has been revived again since a hurricane struck five years earlier. She is shocked to learn the festival is run by her high school sweetheart, Mike.

programme.title: Quest For Love
programme.desc: Mackenzie travels to Costa Rica for work. Her best friend Ethan comes along to get romantic inspiration for his action /adventure novel. Mackenzie has loved Ethan for a long time, but he only sees her as a friend--until a tourist named Lucas makes Ethan see Mackenzie in a new light.

programme.title: Starting Up Love
programme.desc: A young finance executive inherits her uncle's mountain cabin only to discover that he also left half of it to the ruggedly handsome handyman that had been caring for it.

programme.title: The Beautiful Beast
programme.desc: The classic Beauty and the Beast tale told with a twist! Isabelle is all beauty - on the outside. When she gets lost on a skiing vacation, she is helped by Jeremy, a man hiding from the world and his past. He's the first person to put Isabelle in her place, and Isabelle realizes she might be more beast than she wants to admit. Through Jeremy's influence she begins to change - and fall in love.

programme.title: Bookworm and the Beast
programme.desc: Izzy is ready to make a difference in the world as she starts her career in public relations. When Grant Beiste - the big-headed corporate celebrity in town - accidentally hits her father with a car, Izzy is thrown into a public scandal that forces her to work closely with Grant. As she fights to save both her father and Grant's public image, she falls in love and learns not to judge a book by it's cover.

programme.title: The Wrong Marriage
programme.desc: Family frantic about Webb Pam, Stephen rekindle romance Tara investigates Eve.

programme.title: Jewish Federation / Alberto / Tamara
programme.desc: A crazed gunman demands an end to the war in Iraq and shoots four workers.

programme.title: The Wrong Nemesis
programme.desc: Robin may gain fortune via lawyer Sheldon Carrie's efforts expand.

programme.title: The Wrong Murder
programme.desc: Unsure how to handle Eve, Pam asks Sheldon for advice Robin meets boat owner Cam.

programme.title: The Wrong Marriage
programme.desc: Family frantic about Webb Pam, Stephen rekindle romance Tara investigates Eve.

programme.title: Love is a Piece of Cake
programme.desc: A baker develops a budding romance with a client's brother while trying to save her cake shop from developers.

programme.title: A Lethal Lesson
programme.desc: High school teacher Lauren is accused of an affair by a student, putting her job and life in jeopardy.

programme.title: Sugar Baby Murder
programme.desc: A new executive assistant to a business tycoon learns that a life of luxury can come at a deadly price.

programme.title: At Home With Tori
programme.desc: Tori surprises her family with a meal that transports them to Spain.

programme.title: Kill Thy Neighbor
programme.desc: After her husband's death, Julie and her son move near his aunt, Alison, who secretly blames Julie for it.

programme.title: Maid In Manhattan
programme.desc: A woman (Lopez) takes a job as a chambermaid at a luxury hotel in New York. She meets and falls in love with a debonair heir to an America political dynasty (Fiennes), who mistakes her for a society woman. When her real identity is revealed, the truth sets in about the disparity of their lives.

programme.title: Friends with Benefits
programme.desc: When two friends decide to try something new and take advantage of their mutual attraction without any emotional attachment, they soon realize romantic comedy stereotypes might exist for a reason.

programme.title: The House Bunny
programme.desc: The story of a Playboy Bunny who teaches an awkward sorority about the opposite sex - only to learn that what boys really like is what's on the inside.

programme.title: RV (2006)
programme.desc: A forced family vacation in a recreational vehicle rapidly turns into a disaster.

programme.title: Hot Property
programme.desc: Hot Property is an anarchic satire for 'generation rent'. An un-romantic comedy about love, greed and psychotic estate agents. Set amid London's deranged property market and self-parodying hipster culture. STARRING MyAnna Buring (Kill List/Ripper Street/Downton Abbey)

programme.title: Lemon
programme.desc: Isaac is a man in free fall immobilized by mediocrity. His career is going nowhere. His blind girlfriend of ten years is leaving him. And his overbearing family doesn't help matters. What did he do to deserve this? Things were supposed to work out differently for him. Isaac Lachmann had big dreams.

programme.title: Asteroid
programme.desc: An out of touch family man moves back home to a beautiful house on the outskirts of town, but there's one small problem... It's about to be hit by an asteroid.

programme.title: Fanboys
programme.desc: A group of Star Wars fans travel to Skywalker Ranch to steal a copy of "The Phantom Menace" so that their terminally ill friend can see it before it's released in cinemas several months later.

programme.title: Ultimate Gunfighter
programme.desc: Two family clans have always been enemies they spend their time hating and killing each other. The daughter of the Campos family and the son of the Mounter family fall in love, thus causing further hatred and deaths.

programme.title: Madron
programme.desc: A nun, the only survivor of an Indian massacre of a wagon train, is taken in by a cantankerous old gunfighter.

programme.title: Molly And Lawless John
programme.desc: In New Mexico, a sheriff's unhappy mid-aged wife aids a condemned prisoner escape her husband's jail and elopes with the young and attractive outlaw to Mexico, pursued by the sheriff's posse.

programme.title: The Ballad of a Gunfighter
programme.desc: An outlaw and his partner feud over the same woman.

programme.title: The Django Story
programme.desc: Legendary gunslinger Django is recounting some of his greatest adventures while sitting in a saloon.

programme.title: The Lodger: A Story of the London Fog
programme.desc: Silent film based on a Jack the Ripper style serial killer in London.

programme.title: Sapphire
programme.desc: On a bleak winter's day, the body of a beautiful young girl is found on waste land.

programme.title: And Soon the Darkness
programme.desc: Ellie and Stephanie have left their cycling tour group to go it alone around Argentina.

programme.title: House of Secrets
programme.desc: A plot to flood Britain with counterfeit notes is discovered by the CIA in Paris.

programme.title: Demons of the Mind
programme.desc: The disappearance of several girls leads the community to believe that a demon prowls the impenetrable forest

programme.title: Wages of Sydney
programme.desc: Quan Shu, Manchuria 1359 BC: The Chinese invent an explosive gift egg. New York, 2001: A rival beats Sydney and Nigel to a map leading to the Dragon's Egg.

programme.title: Vampires Kiss
programme.desc: Lucas Blackmer, a babe-magnet, professor and a novelist asks Sydney to help find Vlad Tepes' lost relic. And he isn't the only one after it.

programme.title: Mr. Right
programme.desc: Sydney runs into her ex Gray and goes on a holiday with him to Bali, but when Derek Lloyd shows up to enlist her to find Parvati's Bowl, she can't resist.

programme.title: Sydney at Ten
programme.desc: Sydney's roommate from school is on track of a pendant from her past and enlists Sydney to help find it and catch the killer.

programme.title: The Light of Truth
programme.desc: Arabia 843 AD: A sheik uses the Light of Truth to reveal his general as a traitor. 2001: Prince Shareem drops out from Sydney's class to go search for the Light of Truth.

programme.title: Treasure Island
programme.desc: Sydney's on the hunt for a Pirate's booty, but will a traitor force her to walk the plank?

programme.title: Women Want to Know
programme.desc: Sydney has found a temple with an idol of Ganesha and it is being filmed for TV, but they get trapped inside when the local rebels stumble onto them. Can Nigel and Karen help from USA?

programme.title: The Star of Nadir
programme.desc: An anonymous Sultan's wife Danielle dies in mysterious circumstances in the desert. However, she had called for Sydney to help. Sydney believes Danielle was searching for the Star of Nadir.

programme.title: Behind The Line
programme.desc: Occupied France, 1940. A Nazi Commander discovers one of his prisoners, Danny (Sam Gittins) is a champion boxer. He forces him to fight for his companies entertainment.

programme.title: Storm Rider: Legend of Hammerhead
programme.desc: Three centuries after the Great Flood, the land has been reduced to many islands, perpetually menaced by a colossal Storm. The Islanders' only hope for safety lies in the city-state of Argos, attainable through dangerous competitions known as Storm Riding.

programme.title: Killing Season
programme.desc: Two veterans of the Bosnian War - one an American named Benjamin Ford , the other a former Serbian soldier, Emil Kovac - engage in a tense, action-packed cat and mouse game, against the backdrop of America's most forbidding and remote landscape.

programme.title: Ninja: Shadow Of A Tear
programme.desc: Scott Adkins returns as Casey Bowman, who is now the sensei of a successful dojo, married to the beautiful Namiko, and expecting their first baby. But when Casey returns home one day to find someone has brutally killed Namiko, bereft, Casey has only one thing left to live for... Revenge.

programme.title: I Still Know What You Did Last Summer
programme.desc: Haunted by the brutal murders of her friends, Julie James is struggling to lead a normal life as a college freshman in Boston.

programme.title: Enough
programme.desc: Working-class waitress Slim (Jennifer Lopez -The Wedding Planner) thought she was entering a life of domestic bliss when she married Mitch (Billy Campbell - TV's "Once and Again"), the man of her dreams. After the arrival of their first child, her picture perfect life is shattered when she discovers Mitch's hidden possessive dark side, a controlling and abusive alter ego that can turn trust, loveand tranquility into terror.

programme.title: Christine
programme.desc: Based on the novel by Stephen King, CHRISTINE tells the horrific story of a 1957 Plymouth that is bought by a misfit student (Keith Gordon) and refurbished, and takes on human characteristics. Christine, as the Plymouth is called, exacts revenge on everyone who treated her owner badly at school and then gets even more possessive and goes after Gordon's girlfriend.

programme.title: Drunken Master
programme.desc: A young man is unwittingly caught up in a fight between a group trying to steal ancient Chinese artifacts and a group trying to preserve them. He has a unique style of fighting called "Drunken Boxing" which makes him a formidable opponent.
